ns2:course.label: Integrative Ecosystem Mgmt
ns2:course.description: (NRES 356) Examines ecological and human dimensions of ecosystem management through case studies of environmental management settings such as the Greater Yellowstone, Pacific Northwest, Great Lakes, and Mississippi River Basin ecosystems. Capstone course for seniors in natural resource disciplines. Prerequisite: Senior standing; IB 203 or NRES 219 and ACE 100 or ECON 102.
